description: A mistrial was declared Wednesday evening in a Calgary murder trial involving a man who admitted to killing his mother with a rock while high on LSD.
title: Mistrial declared in case of Calgary man who admitted to killing mom while high on LSD

description: The CN Tower is giving rare access to areas of the engineering marvel that are normally closed to the public. CBC News photographer Evan Mitsui checked out the tower's lesser known parts during a media preview on Wednesday.
title: IN PHOTOS | A rare guided tour of the CN Tower's off-limit areas

description: Andrew Chang explains how China's government gave U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio a new, slightly tweaked, name — one that doesn't ban him from entering China. (Photo credits: The Canadian Press, Reuters, Adobe Stock and Getty Images)
title: Marco Rubio's new Chinese name | About That

description: Who introduced Donald Trump and his wife, Melania Trump? For years, Italian entrepreneur and close Trump associate Paolo Zampolli has taken credit, but the release of the Epstein files surfaced an FBI document that said it was financier and convicted sex offender Jeffrey Epstein. What’s the truth? CBC’s visual investigations team and Katie Nicholson dig into the files to reveal surprising new details.
title: Did Jeffrey Epstein really introduce Donald Trump and Melania?

description: The leader of the Official Opposition on P.E.I. is asking the Progressive Conservative government if it's going to support a huge Netflix production set on P.E.I.
title: Province risks losing huge Netflix series filming in P.E.I., Opposition says

description: A Utah mother who published a children's book about grief after the death of her husband will serve a life sentence without the possibility of parole for his murder, a judge ruled Wednesday.
title: Utah woman handed life sentence for fentanyl-laced-cocktail murder of husband

description: The agency in charge of aviation safety in the U.S. says all of its airport vehicles will be equipped with technology to help air-traffic controllers track their movements, a move expedited by the deadly crash in March involving an Air Canada jet at New York's LaGuardia Airport.
title: FAA adding transponders to all its airport vehicles after Air Canada plane's deadly LaGuardia runway crash

description: New York Islanders defenceman Matthew Schaefer has been awarded the Calder Memorial Trophy as the NHL's top rookie.
title: Islanders' Matthew Schaefer first unanimous NHL rookie of the year recipient since 1993

description: The U.S. Senate has confirmed President Donald Trump's nominee to lead the Federal Reserve, Kevin Warsh, bringing new leadership to the world's most powerful central bank at a fraught moment for the global economy.
title: U.S. Senate votes to approves Trump's pick for Federal Reserve chair

description: The murder convictions and life sentence of Alex Murdaugh were overturned Wednesday by the South Carolina Supreme Court because the court clerk at his trial suggested he was guilty, but the disgraced lawyer won't be leaving prison any time soon.
title: Retrial set for lawyer Alex Murdaugh after convictions overturned in deaths of wife, son

description: Russia fired at least 800 drones in a massive daytime barrage on about 20 regions in Ukraine on Wednesday, killing at least six people and wounding dozens, including children, in one of the longest attacks by Moscow in the four-year-old war, Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said.
title: At least 6 dead after Russia fires hundreds of drones at Ukraine in hours-long attack

description: A licensed drug addiction counsellor who delivered Friends star Matthew Perry the doses of ketamine that killed him receivd his sentence on Wednesday.
title: Drug counsellor who delivered fatal ketamine doses to Matthew Perry gets 2 years in prison

description: Bill 4, tabled on Wednesday, would allow people who fear for their safety or that of their children to obtain information about the conjugal violence history of their current or ex-partner.
title: Quebec proposes law allowing people to obtain intimate partner violence history of partners

description: In a decision described as "historic," a Manitoba judge has found the governments of Manitoba and Canada breached First Nations' rights to self-governance around child welfare.
title: Federal, Manitoba governments breached First Nations' child welfare rights, judge says in 'historic' decision

description: Five Canadian cyclists are prepared to fight back after it was announced Cycling Canada would not be sending a women’s pursuit team to this year’s world championships slated for Oct. 14-18.
title: Cycling Canada is cutting women's pursuit team. These Canadian riders have launched an appeal

description: Public Safety Minister Gary Anandasangaree accused U.S. tech giants of "misinterpreting" his lawful access bill, which promises to give police and spies faster access to Canadians' information during investigations, as the proposed legislation faces growing backlash south of the border.
title: Facing mounting backlash, Anandasangaree says U.S. tech companies are 'misinterpreting' his lawful access bill

description: The federal government and the Alberta government are nailing down a deal on industrial carbon pricing, largely considered Canada's most important policy for driving down harmful greenhouse gas pollution.
title: Ottawa, Alberta near deal on carbon pricing rising to $130/tonne by 2040

description: Gunshots broke out at the Philippine Senate on Wednesday and people ran for cover after a top politician wanted by the International Criminal Court said his arrest was imminent and security forces entered the building.
title: Gunshots in Philippine Senate as politician wanted by ICC urges people to mobilize

description: From UFOs to missing scientists, fringe ideas and conspiracy theories have come to the forefront during U.S. President Donald Trump’s second administration. This week, Washington correspondents Katie Simpson, Paul Hunter and Willy Lowry dig into the long history of conspiracy theories intersecting with American politics.
title: From UFOs to missing scientists, has Trump made conspiracy theories mainstream?

description: U.S. President Donald Trump said on Tuesday he isn't thinking about the financial situation of Americans as he tries to navigate a path toward a ceasefire with Iran, as the economic impacts of the conflict that began in late February start to become more apparent in the U.S.
title: Trump's dismissal of Americans' inflation concerns fuels Democrats' midterm campaigns

description: Crews fighting to contain a fire threatening homes mere kilometres from the community of Whitecourt are bracing for gusting winds Wednesday that could fan the flames.

description: Prime Minister Mark Carney welcomed the Artemis II astronauts to Ottawa Wednesday telling them their recent trip around the moon has served as an inspiration for the whole country.
title: Carney tells Artemis II astronauts their mission around the moon inspired a country

description: The PWHL will add expansion teams in Hamilton and Las Vegas ahead of next season, the latest step in the league's rapid expansion plan. The league announced the two cities on Wednesday.

description: Brad Gushue was named high-performance director for USA Curling on Wednesday.
title: Canadian curling great Brad Gushue named high-performance director for U.S. team

description: The Toronto Maple Leafs fired head coach Craig Berube on Wednesday after two seasons. New general manager John Chayka says the decision was tied to an organizational reset and a desire for a fresh start, while praising Berube's leadership and professionalism.
title: Desiring a fresh start, Maple Leafs fire head coach Craig Berube after 2 seasons

description: The mother of a one-year-old girl has been charged with first-degree murder after the child died in hospital Wednesday, Toronto police say.
title: Mother charged with murder in death of 1-year-old girl: Toronto police

description: The 2026 Eurovision Song Contest has devolved into its worst crisis in history, marked by a historic five-country boycott and audience protests over Israel’s participation amid the war in Gaza.

description: Israel has escalated its attacks in Gaza in the five weeks since halting its joint bombing with the U.S. in Iran, redirecting its fire back on the ruined Palestinian enclave where the military believes Hamas fighters are tightening their grip.

description: The list of electors, which was made public through a searchable database, contains personal voter information. Privacy experts say vulnerable Albertans face the most risk from the breach.
title: What does the Elections Alberta voter information breach mean for your privacy?

description: Maskwa Games and Métis Nation—Saskatchewan (MN-S) have partnered up to deliver a Roblox game that is a virtual copy of the Back to Batoche festival and grounds.
title: Coming soon to Roblox: Back to Batoche, Métis history and the Michif language

description: A family is calling for an inquest after an intellectually disabled man who was being cared for at a Manitoba group home died in hospital with significant malnutrition.
title: A disabled man living in a group home died malnourished in hospital. His family wants answers

description: Some former students of Vancouver College say a proposed $30-million settlement is meaningless without an apology and an admission of liability for the abuse they allegedly suffered at the hands of Christian Brothers linked to the Mount Cashel Orphanage.
title: No apology included in proposed $30M settlement for Christian Brothers abuse case

description: An Ottawa man is among critics urging stronger oversight of Canada's international visa hubs — run by a federal contractor paid hundreds of millions taxpayer dollars — after what he describes as "unjustifiable" and "shady" experiences at a visa centre in Bangladesh.

description: Ahmed came to Canada as an international student planning to return home — until falling in love with another man forced him to confront the dangers he says he faces in Pakistan. Now, a new federal asylum law could make his refugee claim ineligible before he even got a hearing.

description: Euphemistic ads for ED medication are as old as the internet, but in recent years, direct-to-consumer pharmaceutical companies are using memes and unmistakable messaging to reach young men concerned about their sexual health on social media. Doctors caution young men often only need medication after steps like lifestyle changes haven’t improved sexual health and performance.

description: A scarcity of aluminum cans due the war in Iran means there's a Diet Coke shortage in India, where the drink only comes in cans. As a result, people there are hoarding the beverages and throwing parties to celebrate their favourite drink.
title: Is there a Diet Coke shortage? What to know about India's 'candemic'

description: We shouldn't be surprised that some of the best horror in 2026 is coming from a very online sketch comedian. Obsession, from 26-year-old Curry Barker, is about to change horror for good.
title: Obsession — and the internet — is about to change the face of horror

description: The ascendant Reform UK leader says Preston Manning, the wonkish Canadian populist pioneer, is his inspiration.
title: The Canadian inspiration for Britain's surging right-wing Reform party
